“Mr. Morgan is very busy to-day,” Parker reiterated stubbornly.

284The valet’s face remained expressionless.

“Looks as though he was going to be cleaned out to-day, eh?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u030-r0105", "tag": "p", "text": "“For a second time I tell you he is very busy——” he began.", "sha256": "1667b9fe2b9c517ceb31cbefd1005517591d8eef2122aa190569a08f2af747a8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2609]", "source_html": "
